PRICE: 31 $/ PERSON

Included:

• AC Transportation

• English speaking guide

• Lunch

• Water

• Entrance fees

Excluded:

• Beverages

• Personal expenses

• Drinks

• Travel Insurance

• Tips for guide and driver

What to bring:

• A hat & sunscreen

• Appropriate clothing for the season

• Comfortable walking shoes/ clothes

• If you’re going to see Ho Chi Minh’s Mausoleum, you should not wear shorts

CHILDREN POLICY

• Children under 5 years old (or under 1m high): Free of charge based on 2 adults 1 kid sharing bed/ berth/ bus with adult

• Children from 5 – 8 year old: charge 75% adult price, sharing bed with adult

• Children from 9 year old above: charge as adult price
